svg.title: Three ways IBM counts its analytics and planning software
svg.desc: Three ways IBM counts these products: per authorized user, for Cognos Analytics Standard or Premium, SPSS Statistics and Planning Analytics Premium; per 16 gigabytes, for Planning Analytics Standard; per instance, for Planning Analytics Essentials.
